findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for HTTP requests; translations in jobs/mailers never fall back
findings.body: The new `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` call loads the user locale, the site default locale and `:en`, but it only runs inside `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any translation performed outside a controller request — Sidekiq jobs, mailer/notification rendering, rake tasks, the console, specs — never executes it. In those contexts `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` still only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`, and the i18n `Fallbacks` backend invokes `Base#translate` (not `I18n.translate`) for each fallback, so it never triggers loading of the fallback locale files. Consequence: in a separate Sidekiq/mailer process, a key missing from, e.g., `de.yml` will not resolve to `:en` and will emit "translation missing" instead of falling back. The fallback-chain loading should live inside `I18n.translate`/`ensure_loaded!` rather than relying on the controller before_filter.

findings.title: Fallback chain mixes String and Symbol locales, defeating uniq and double-loading the YAML
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` builds `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`. For anonymous requests `set_locale` assigns `I18n.locale = SiteSetting.default_locale`, which is a String, so `locale` is (for example) `"en"` while the site default is `:en`. `uniq` does not treat the String and Symbol as equal, so the chain becomes `["en", :en]`. Both values are then passed to `I18n.ensure_loaded!`, and because `@loaded_locales` stores them as distinct entries, `en.yml` is parsed twice on the first request and the same locale is translated twice inside the Fallbacks backend. Normalize the locale (e.g. `locale.to_sym`) when constructing the array.

findings.title: No tests for the new server-side fallback behavior
findings.body: This change reworks how locale fallbacks are configured (dropping `config.i18n.fallbacks = true`, adding `FallbackLocaleList`, and adding `I18n.ensure_loaded!`) and directly affects user-visible output when translations are missing. No specs were added to verify that a key absent from a non-English locale resolves to the site default and then English, that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` actually loads the fallback locale files, or that pluralization still works through the fallback chain. Add request/unit coverage for these paths before merging, since a regression here silently produces "translation missing" strings.
